description: Feature-dev records an adjacent refactor the ACs do not need instead of widening scope or dropping it.
failure_mode: Model implements the unrelated refactor (scope creep), emits SCOPE_DISCOVERED for it, or silently drops it.
prompt: While implementing issue #412 (add an --json flag to `nightgauge status`), you notice internal/forge/client.go duplicates a retry loop in three places. The issue's acceptance criteria hold without touching it. What do you do? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"action": "record_discovered_work" | "emit_scope_discovered" | "implement_now" | "ignore", "source_stage": "feature-dev" | "feature-planning" | "none", "counts_toward_scope_threshold": true | false}

assertions.description: records instead of widening or dropping
recorded work is outside the SCOPE_DISCOVERED threshold
